label: A being is in POTENCY_1 in a respect exactly when it is able to be so…, by Biconditional chaining…
rule: Biconditional chaining through a middle term
meaning: Potency is capacity under privation (OPEN), and in a capable subject privation is lack of the act (OPEN); hence potency is unactualized capacity, the Metaphysics IX.6 reading. Middle term: privation. It routes the act/potency analysis through the Physics I subject-privation analysis; both premises stay open.
